We are seeking an experienced Project Manager with an engineering background to lead satellite projects. You’ll be working on both large and small-scale projects for international customers, requiring a high degree of independence, resilience, and a broad engineering foundation. If you're organized, enthusiastic about project management, and ready to set new standards in modern space technology, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

• Lead and manage satellite projects from initial concept to in-orbit operations.

• Engage with clients and maintain open communication throughout project lifecycles.

• Plan and manage tasks with the project team to ensure project timelines and budgets are met.

• Collaborate closely with team leads to plan, prioritize, and ensure smooth execution of tasks, meeting technical milestones and project timelines.

• Monitor project progress, ensuring adherence to scope, budget, and quality standards.

• Oversee launch logistics, deployment, in-orbit commissioning, and daily operations of satellites.

• Inspire and motivate team members to meet deadlines and achieve project milestones.

• Experience from running new space ESA projects and knowledge of the ECSS standards is required..

• Solution-oriented, with the ability to focus on project goals despite minor setbacks.

• Self-driven and able to take ownership of your tasks and responsibilities.

• Skilled in time management and coordinating team efforts to meet deadlines.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

• Educational background in engineering preferably Satellite System Engineering, coupled with project management experience and certifications like PMP or Prince2.

• Team player, resourceful, and able to utilize both personal and company resources effectively.

• A full-time role with exposure to a variety of disciplines within space technology.

• A position in an exciting, rapidly growing industry with significant international reach.

• A chance to shape your role and responsibilities within a growing company.

• Great colleagues and several social events each year.

• Health insurance and additional employee benefits.

• Competitive salary and good working conditions.

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, apply by submitting your CV and application. If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact us via jobs@space-inventor.com, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

Interviews are held continuously until the right candidate is found.

Start date to be agreed, but preferably with start-up as soon as possible.

We look forward to receiving your application.

Space Inventor is a leading Satellite company with a passion for exploring space and delivering innovative solutions in satellite technology. Our mission is to revolutionize the space industry with creativity, technical expertise, and reliability. With our 250+ years of combined experience in the space industry, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what satellites can achieve.

BWSC is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Legal Counsel to join our legal team in Allerød, Denmark. In this role, you will play a key part in managing legal matters across the business, ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations, and providing practical, strategic legal guidance to our business units. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an international company with a global reach and a strong focus on sustainable energy solutions.

BWSC – Ever better energy!

Join us in our mission in building a world of sustainable energy and making a meaningful impact on the world of power generation and energy conversion.

BWSC is a leading player in the power generation industry, specializing in the service, operations, and maintenance of power plants. We are seeking to always provide Ever Better Energy whether it comes to optimizing a conventional power plant, operating a biomass power plant or constructing new energy facilities. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and environmental stewardship sets us apart in the industry.

The position

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be part of BWSC’s legal team and report directly to the General Counsel. You will work closely with management and key stakeholders across the organization, providing legal advice that supports BWSC’s commercial activities, corporate governance and strategic priorities.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Providing expert legal advice on a wide range of topics, including contract law, commercial transactions, corporate governance, company law, and dispute resolution.

• Drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts and agreements that are critical to our projects, partnerships, and business operations.

• Identifying and mitigating legal risks by conducting thorough risk assessments and advising on effective strategies.

• Supporting corporate governance efforts, ensuring compliance with local and international regulations, company policies, and corporate structures.

• Collaborating with external legal counsel on specialized legal issues and complex cases.

• Staying ahead of legal developments by monitoring relevant legislation, industry regulations, and trends to ensure BWSC’s compliance.

• Managing dispute resolution processes, including litigation and arbitration, to protect the company’s interests.

• Educating internal teams on legal matters, such as contract management, compliance, and corporate policies, to foster a culture of legal awareness.

Qualifications

At BWSC, we believe that our people are the foundation of our success. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will bring solid legal expertise, sound business judgement and the ability to navigate complex legal matters in close collaboration with internal stakeholders.

The ideal candidate thrives in an international environment, works independently and has the following background and experience:

• Holds a Danish Master of Laws degree or equivalent legal qualification.

• Possesses a strong understanding of Danish law and relevant international legal frameworks, with experience in cross-border transactions and dispute resolution.

• Is fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• Has at least 5 years of legal experience, preferably in-house or with a law firm, specializing in commercial contracts, corporate law, or the energy/industrial sector.

• Demonstrates excellent drafting and negotiation skills with attention to detail.

• Exhibits strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Can work independently, manage multiple tasks, and prioritize effectively.

• Shows a high degree of professionalism, integrity, and the ability to collaborate with management, clients, and external partners.

What do we offer?

At BWSC, you will have the opportunity to work in an international company that values innovation, collaboration and personal development. We offer flexible working conditions and an inspiring work environment where you can make a real difference.

We have a good canteen, fitness facilities and an active Staff Club that contributes with various events and activities. Our HQ is located in Allerød, close to the train station and only a 30-minute ride from central Copenhagen.

We look forward to hearing from you

We review applications and invite relevant candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible. The job posting will be closed once we have found the right candidate.

We look forward to receiving your application. If you have any questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact Nicolai Lygum at nily@bwsc.dk.

BWSC wants to promote equality and diversity. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply - regardless of ethnic background, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or age. We therefore recommend not stating age etc. on application documents.

Due to GDPR requirements, BWSC does not receive or process applications submitted by email. To ensure that your application is processed, please submit it via our online recruitment system.

FirePoint Rocket Technology is building one of the most unique and strategically important industrial projects in Denmark - a new production facility for solid rocket propellant and advanced defense-tech components. Our ambition is significant: we are scaling from the early operational phase to 200+ employees within the next 18 months.

It is a Danish-based defense technology company, part of the international Fire Point Group — a fast-growing ecosystem born out of Ukraine’s innovation and resilience. The group was founded by engineers and entrepreneurs who, during the first months of the full-scale war, decided to use their expertise to create advanced defense technologies — including long-range drones and precision systems.

Joining FPRT now means becoming part of the core team shaping a new high-tech, safety-critical production environment from the ground up.

They are looking for a Maintenance & Engineering Manager who will establish and execute an absolute, zero-compromise reliability strategy from day one.

The Role

As the Maintenance & Engineering Manager, you are responsible for the operational integrity, availability, and safety of all production assets and process equipment. Manufacturing rocket propellant leaves no room for trial and error—our process equipment must be predictable, fully mastered down to the individual component, and maintained at peak condition.

Reporting directly to the Chief Production Officer (CPO), you will lead the technical team in deep equipment mastery, anticipating service intervals with precision, and proactively replacing high-risk components before failures occur. You will work in close functional alignment with Process Engineering, Manufacturing Automation, EHS, Quality, and Production Planning to ensure seamless, compliant operations.

What You Will Do

1. Production Maintenance Strategy & Asset Management

• Develop and implement a preventive and predictive maintenance strategy for all production equipment, focusing on long-cycle and batch-based processes (mixers, thermal curing ovens, polymerization, climate-controlled chambers) to ensure thermal stability and high uptime.

• Minimize downtime by transitioning from reactive repairs to condition-based monitoring and planned interventions.

• Lead the selection, implementation, and management of a CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) to track work orders, asset history, and maintenance costs.

• Integrate maintenance requirements into the equipment acquisition process alongside QA, establishing preventive risk assessments and managing obsolescence planning.

2. Process Utilities & Production Support Engineering

• Oversee point-of-use process utilities directly feeding production lines, such as process vacuum, specialized process gas loops, and line-dedicated thermal fluids.

• Coordinate with internal and external facility teams on utility drop interfaces to ensure production machinery interface readiness.

3. EHS & Process Safety Compliance

• Enforce strict adherence to EHS standards across all equipment maintenance activities.

• Rigorously execute Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures and "Permit to Work" systems on energetic material processing machinery and hazardous equipment zones.

4. Production Spare Parts & Technical Inventory

• Define critical spare parts strategies for production machinery to balance inventory costs with operational risk mitigation.

• Partner with the Warehouse team to track, store, and preserve technical production spares correctly.

• Monitor market lifecycle status for key equipment components and execute end-of-life obsolescence planning.

5. Team Leadership & Technical Development

• Lead, mentor, and schedule a team of production maintenance technicians and equipment specialists.

• Ensure the team is fully trained in safety protocols (ATEX, energetic materials) and advanced technical troubleshooting.

• Plan technician resources and build mechanical redundancy strategies to protect production during interventions or unplanned events.

6. Production Line CapEx & Commissioning Support

• Support the installation, mechanical integration, and commissioning of new production lines with Process Engineering and Automation.

• Provide early input on machine "serviceability and accessibility" during the design phase to eliminate future shop-floor bottlenecks.

First 90 Days – Expected Outcomes

• Critical spare parts inventory analysis completed and gaps identified.

• Preventative Maintenance (PM) schedule established for all key production assets.

• Maintenance team skills matrix assessed and training plan initiated.

• Design of the “obtain equipment” process and equipment lifecycle framework completed in collaboration with QA.

What We Offer

• A rare career opportunity to lead the engineering and maintenance function for one of Denmark's most unique industrial and defense-tech projects.

• A role where your technical expertise directly determines the reliability and safety of high-stakes, safety-critical production.

• A professional, international environment with a clear mission and purpose.

• Brand-new factory & equipment.

• Real authority, Greenfield impact, Zero toxic culture, Mastery over busywork.

• Top-of-market compensation for the right experience.

We Are Looking For

You are a highly structured, disciplined, and hands-on leader who thrives on the shop floor and maintains an absolute zero-compromise approach to equipment safety and operational reliability.

Requirements:

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Marine Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Experience: 5+ years of maintenance management experience within heavy industry, chemical processing, pharma, defense, or similar high-safety manufacturing environments.

• Leadership: Proven track record of managing technical teams, scheduling resources, and coordinating external contractors and facility service providers.

• Regulatory Knowledge: Experience working in highly regulated environments (ATEX, SEVESO, or similar energetic/hazardous contexts).

• Systems & Methods: Experience implementing or optimizing CMMS systems (e.g., SAP PM, Maximo) and utilizing OEE and Root Cause Analysis (FMEA, 8D, 5 Whys).

• Technical Mastery: Strong working knowledge of mechanical systems (hydraulics, pneumatics, rotating equipment), electrical systems, and industrial automation (PLC, SCADA).

jobs.occupation: Senior Embedded Software Engineer, Real-Time Vision - Simulator Technology
jobs.description:
Shape the future of real-time vision in sports technology

Join Trackman’s new Simulator Technology team and help build next-generation camera systems for the world’s leading golf simulators. We are looking for an experienced engineer with expertise in real-time video pipelines, camera integration, and low-latency systems.

About the team

Trackman is the global leader in indoor golf technology, delivering advanced simulator experiences through precision tracking, virtual golf software, and in-bay technology.

Our new Simulator Technology´s (SimTech) mission is to drive innovation across the entire in-bay customer experience: cameras, projectors, kiosks, moving floors, and the software that ties them together. The team works in close collaboration with Trackman's hardware, tracking, ML, and Virtual Golf teams to deliver seamless, world-class experiences. This is a unique opportunity to become one of the first engineers shaping the future of Trackman’s simulator technology used by elite athletes and golfers around the world.

The role

You will help build a Windows-based real-time vision platform that captures camera streams, runs AI-based image analysis, and outputs video overlays. The role focuses on low-latency camera integration and high-performance video pipelines. This work sits at the heart of SimTech's camera platform the low-level foundation that everything from swing capture to AI coaching will be built on. Our current team is strong in vision/ML, and we need an engineer who specializes in camera integration and real-time video pipelines.

What you will do

• 
Design and implement low-latency camera capture pipelines on Windows.

• 
Integrate with 3rd party cameras using vendor SDKs as well as our own custom camera modules

• 
Build reliable frame pipelines from capture to inference handoff to overlay output.

• 
Optimize for stable FPS, low jitter, and deterministic end-to-end latency.

• 
Implement robust camera lifecycle handling: hot-plug, disconnect/reconnect, error recovery.

• 
Work closely with ML engineers to define frame formats, metadata, and timing contracts.

• 
Build diagnostics: dropped-frame counters, latency telemetry, and health logging.

• 
Support production readiness across different camera models and hardware configurations.

Success in this role means delivering stable, low-latency dual-camera pipelines with reliable recovery mechanisms, robust telemetry, and a well-documented architecture that enables the broader SimTech team to confidently build on the platform.

Job requirements

• 
5+ years in real-time video, machine vision, or camera systems engineering.

• 
Strong C++ (C++17 or newer) - preferably on Windows.

• 
Hands-on with Media Foundation and/or DirectShow capture stacks.

• 
Proven integration experience with industrial camera SDKs (IDS peak / uEye SDK strongly preferred).

• 
Deep understanding of pixel formats, color conversion, timestamps, and buffering.

• 
Solid grasp of USB3 Vision / GenICam concepts and camera controls (exposure, gain, trigger modes).

• 
Experience with multithreaded/parallel pipelines and performance profiling.

• 
Practical OpenCV experience for image handling and overlay operations.

• 
Experience designing fault-tolerant long-running services/applications.

Preferred qualifications: Experience with GStreamer or FFmpeg, GPU acceleration, multi-camera synchronization, inference runtimes, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and GenICam / USB3 Vision standards is considered a plus.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

For additional information about the position, please contact Anton Husby at anton.husby@trackman.recruitee.com Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

Job description

Trackman is the leading brand in its field, trusted by elite athletes worldwide. We’re growing and looking for a Senior Full Stack SDET who is passionate about quality engineering and excited to help test and improve world-class sports technology products.

This senior, full-stack quality engineering role spans backend API testing and frontend (Windows and web) application testing. You’ll combine strong automation skills with the ability to define end-to-end quality strategies across the Trackman ecosystem—from radar data pipelines to TM Performance Studio used by athletes and coaches worldwide.

You’ll join an international team and help elevate quality practices by mentoring peers, partnering closely with developers, product owners, and UI/UX designers, and championing a quality-first approach throughout the development lifecycle.

As our Senior Reward Analyst you will join a close-knit Reward team, working cross-functionally with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and fellow "Trusties" to drive data-informed people decisions. Analyze market data to inform compensation and benefit decisions that will enhance our ability to attract top talent across the countries the business operates

• 
Stay up to date with market trends and legislation to advise identify risks and opportunities

• 
Support/lead on activities required to deliver a well communicated and accurate annual salary review, bonus calculation, equity grants, benefits window and promotion cycles.

Partner with Finance on budget modelling, cost analysis and scenario planning.

• 
Support the design of new/updated benefits, short term incentives and long term incentives

• 
Run regular pay equity analysis and support statutory gender pay gap reporting (EU, UK and any other applicable countries).

Ensure reward practices comply with relevant employment and pay transparency regulations

• 
Maintain job architecture, levelling and job evaluation consistency across the organisation

• 
Build and maintain dashboarding to give leadership visibility on reward health

• 
Prove robust analysis on key reward topics (share dilution, range penetration, pay mix)

Utilise AI in a compliant way to deliver efficient solutions

Partner with HR Business Partners and Talent Acquisition on reward topics to gain a deep understanding of the business needs and ensure they have the data and expert advice needed to make people decisions

Create and communicate clear and user friendly total reward communications and educational material (including ad hoc comms, cyclical communications, benefits communications and total reward statements)
